message.content: According to the discussion on 20260522, IllidanStormrage suggests planning some quiet hours when the children are playing to minimize disruption to their activities. He also proposes that comfort and relaxation areas, such as shaded spots, be included to ensure that the children and adults can enjoy the garden space without being disturbed by the ongoing construction. Additionally, he suggests including some local wildlife-friendly plants to attract pollinators like bees and butterflies, which would add life and vitality to the garden.
